final: WITH rc AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City AS City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM rc), ca AS (SELECT City, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM rc GROUP BY City) SELECT rc.City, SUM(rc.cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(rc.cnt - ca.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess, AVG(rc.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM rc JOIN ca ON ca.City = rc.City CROSS JOIN tot WHERE rc.cnt > ca.avg_cnt GROUP BY rc.City
